title: Living Legend Rewamped
description: A clean and optimized PvP/SMP resource pack with low particles, smooth GUI, and enhanced visuals for better gameplay.
body:
[![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ec6f3501deba4026bb8818757f2d9f1b4b2537a.png)](https://discord.gg/Hx6dtWck)

Living Legend Rewamp is a clean and lightweight Minecraft resource pack inspired by the visual style and gameplay experience associated with India's well-known PvP player, **Living Legend**.

This fan-made rework modernizes the original **80K Pack** with cleaner visuals, refined textures, and an improved presentation while preserving the familiar competitive experience players love.

### 

# 🌊 Overview

Living Legend Rewamp is designed for players who enjoy clean visuals without sacrificing Minecraft's original aesthetic. Every texture has been refined to create a smoother PvP experience while remaining lightweight enough for everyday Survival and SMP gameplay.

Choose between two different variants depending on whether you prefer a more vanilla appearance or a slightly enhanced competitive look.
